scope: UIKit mounting, real public load/render route, same-cell counterexample assertions and owned cleanup only. Interfaces owns the HTTP closure and two test implementations.
lifecycleSequence: Use a genuine foregroundActive UIWindowScene and a retained UIWindow with AnyNativeEditorController as the actual visible controller. Require controller.view.window === window and controller.isForegroundMounted. Preserve the previous key window for final restoration.

Actual viewDidAppear calls presentation.mount(surface: self), render(), then schedules a public presentation.load() Task. Do not also invoke viewDidAppear manually. Before changing the fixture, wait for a genuine first published read with expected version and exact source bytes, isLoading=false, isMounted=true and no pending edits. isLoading=false alone is not an initial-load completion witness.

Call the existing public controller.render() and layout after the first load. A raw UIKit fixture has no SwiftUI updateUIViewController to perform this render automatically. Locate the UITableView through accessibilityIdentifier any-native-editor-blocks and the target UITextView through any-native-block-<blockID>. Retain the actual public UITableViewCell and UITextView references.

After the initial snapshot has settled, keep all ordered block IDs and their order fixed. Make the actual editable target first responder and place a nonempty NSRange entirely in a common unchanged ASCII prefix. Capture the actual range after focus/layout, both raw text encodings, target version, visible index path, window and content-size category.

Change only the controlled current source and legitimate native revision/version, then await the real public presentation.load() after the initial read is settled. Confirm the new exact source and version reached the model without drafts/composition. Call public render() and layout; same IDs select configureVisibleCells directly rather than replacing the diffable snapshot.

Require identical UITableViewCell and UITextView references, same target identifier/window, current visible row, first-responder status and chosen valid selection. Compare model source and UIKit text/attributed text via actual UTF-8 and UTF-16 arrays to the expected new values. Retain actual observations before throwing assertions where the chosen test framework stops on the first failure.
counterexampleInvariants: The chosen old/new pair must be canonically equal as Swift Strings but have distinct UTF-8 arrays; Latin NFC/NFD should also expose the expected UTF-16 length difference. Hebrew reordered combining marks may retain UTF-16 length while differing in exact code units.

Initial model and rendered text must be exactly the old bytes. The second model read must be exactly the new bytes before the rendered-value assertion. Neither phase may set UITextView.text/attributedText or private cache state directly.

Keep target block type, native style value, preferredContentSizeCategory and interface direction unchanged. applyInterfaceDirection explicitly clears cached source, which would allow the old predicate to pass and invalidate this regression.

Keep the same target visible without navigation, reparenting, scrolling offscreen, explicit reload or source-order changes. Object identity alone does not prove absence of prepareForReuse; the unchanged-ID direct-render path and continuously mounted visible row provide the required source/lifecycle constraint.

The old predicate sees canonical-equal cached/new source and unchanged style/type/category, so it skips rendering while the model holds new raw text. The corrected predicate reaches the already exact shared renderer; its replace path saves and restores a selection valid in both strings.
Do not require old Undo retention. An external native version change deliberately increments textHistoryEpochs and clears stale edit history. That behavior is independent of this cache defect.
cleanupRisks: viewWillDisappear only unmounts on actual removal/dismissal conditions. Hiding an owned test window or clearing rootViewController alone must not be treated as proof that presentation observations drained.

Every success and throwing assertion path must perform the fixture owner's async cleanup, including presentation.drain(), original session/lifetime closure and joining the in-process HTTP/observation tasks; then restore the prior key window. Do not launch a detached cleanup Task from defer and claim it joined.

Actual canMutate/shouldBeginEditing requires the original mounted lifetime, writable read and foreground surface. A real UIKit window may test these fixture conditions, but fixture member/permissions are not verified Native production authority.
existingCoverage: The hosted empty-paragraph suite mounts only AnyNativeTextView under a plain UIViewController. Renderer3 calls AnyNativeTextRenderer directly. Neither provides an existing complete public-load presentation fixture or exercises configure's cached-source predicate.
pending: Interfaces must implement and source-review its exact original-route HTTP fixture and two full controller tests. Apple compilation and execution remain necessary; this document makes no mounted PASS claim.
